description: This file provides test infrastructure for CookieMonster's cookie store, including mock classes and helper functions for testing cookie store commands and behaviors.

classes.name: CookieStoreCommand
classes.description: Represents a command to the persistent cookie store, such as load, add, or remove cookies.

classes.name: MockPersistentCookieStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of PersistentCookieStore that records commands for testing.

classes.name: MockSimplePersistentCookieStore
classes.description: A simple mock cookie store acting as a backing database for testing.

methods.name: set_store_load_commands
methods.description: Sets whether Load commands are stored in the command list instead of being executed immediately.

methods.name: SetLoadExpectation
methods.description: Configures the return value and result for Load operations.

methods.name: TakeCommands
methods.description: Returns and clears the list of recorded commands.

methods.name: TakeCallbackAt
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the callback at a specific index.

methods.name: BuildCanonicalCookie
methods.description: Creates a CanonicalCookie object from URL, cookie string, and creation time.

methods.name: AddCookieToList
methods.description: Adds a cookie to a list of CanonicalCookies.

methods.name: CreateMonsterFromStoreForGC
methods.description: Creates a CookieMonster with a mock store pre-filled with specified cookies for garbage collection testing.
